item.text: The remaining goals need finite array expansion and heap reordering. I’m using `join_comm`, `join_assoc`, and `unit_join` to preserve the existing witnesses; the zero-length list equality reduces directly.

arguments.code:
var helper = `
Lemma finite_sep_intro (P Q : CRules.expr) a b h :
  join a b h -> P a -> Q b -> (P ** Q) h.
Proof.
  intros J HP HQ. exists a, b.
  repeat first [ assumption | split ].
Qed.

Lemma finite_and_intro (P Q : CRules.expr) h :
  P h -> Q h -> (P && Q) h.
Proof. intros HP HQ; split; assumption. Qed.

Lemma finite_pure_intro (P : Prop) h : P -> (“ P ”) h.
Proof. intros HP; exact HP. Qed.

Ltac finite_unpack H :=
  lazymatch type of H with
  | (?P ** ?Q) ?h =>
      let a := fresh "ha" in let b := fresh "hb" in
      let K := fresh "parts" in
      destruct H as [a [b K]];
      repeat match type of K with
      | _ /\\ _ => let K1 := fresh "part" in destruct K as [K1 K]
      end;
      repeat match goal with
      | K : _ /\\ _ |- _ => destruct K
      end;
      repeat match goal with
      | K : (_ ** _) _ |- _ => finite_unpack K
      end
  | _ => idtac
  end.

Ltac finite_joins acc :=
  match goal with
  | J : join ?a ?b ?c |- _ =>
      let T := type of J in
      revert J;
      finite_joins constr:((a,b,c,acc));
      intro J
  | _ => constr:(acc)
  end.

Ltac finite_comm_all :=
  let rec collect acc :=
    match goal with
    | J : join ?a ?b ?c |- _ =>
      let Jc := fresh "commuted" in
      let K := fresh "saved" in
      rename J into K;
      revert K;
      collect acc;
      intro K;
      pose proof (join_comm _ _ _ K) as Jc
    | _ => idtac
    end in collect constr:(tt).

Ltac finite_assoc_round :=
  let rec outer :=
    match goal with
    | J : join ?ab ?c ?h |- _ =>
      let rec inner :=
        match goal with
        | K : join ?a ?b ab |- _ =>
          let U := fresh "assoc_parts" in
          let bc := fresh "hbc" in
          let J1 := fresh "assoc_join" in
          let J2 := fresh "assoc_join" in
          pose proof (join_assoc _ _ _ _ _ K J) as U;
          revert K; inner; intro K;
          destruct U as [bc [J1 J2]]
        | _ => idtac
        end in
      revert J; outer; intro J; inner
    | _ => idtac
    end in outer.

Ltac finite_units :=
  let rec scan :=
    match goal with
    | h : model |- _ =>
      let u := fresh "unit_heap" in
      let U := fresh "unit_fact" in
      let J := fresh "unit_join_fact" in
      let H := fresh "unit_parts" in
      pose proof (unit_join h) as H;
      revert h; scan; intro h;
      destruct H as [u [U J]];
      change (emp u) in U
    | _ => idtac
    end in scan.

Ltac finite_heap :=
  intros h H;
  finite_unpack H;
  finite_comm_all;
  finite_assoc_round;
  finite_comm_all;
  finite_units;
  eauto 14 using finite_sep_intro, finite_and_intro, finite_pure_intro.

Ltac finite_array :=
  cbn [CharArray.seg CharArray.full store_array store_array_rec
       StoreCharAsElement.storeA repeat_Z];
  repeat rewrite sizeof_char;
  cbn;
  finite_heap.

`;

Require Import ExecutionGoal.
Require Import Coq.ZArith.ZArith.
Require Import Coq.Bool.Bool.
Require Import Coq.Strings.String.
Require Import Coq.Strings.Ascii.
Require Import Coq.Lists.List.
Require Import Coq.Classes.RelationClasses.
Require Import Coq.Classes.Morphisms.
Require Import Coq.micromega.Psatz.
Require Import Coq.Sorting.Permutation.
From AUXLib Require Import int_auto Axioms Feq Idents ListLib VMap.
Require Import SetsClass.SetsClass. Import SetsNotation.
From SimpleC.SL Require Import Mem SeparationLogic.
Require Import Logic.LogicGenerator.demo932.Interface.
Local Open Scope Z_scope.
Local Open Scope sets.
Local Open Scope string_scope.
Local Open Scope list.
Import naive_C_Rules.
Local Open Scope sac.
Local Open Scope Z_scope.



Lemma finite_sep_intro (P Q : CRules.expr) a b h :
  join a b h -> P a -> Q b -> (P ** Q) h.
Proof.
  intros J HP HQ. exists a, b.
  repeat first [ assumption | split ].
Qed.

Lemma finite_and_intro (P Q : CRules.expr) h :
  P h -> Q h -> (P && Q) h.
Proof. intros HP HQ; split; assumption. Qed.

Lemma finite_pure_intro (P : Prop) h : P -> (“ P ”) h.
Proof. intros HP; exact HP. Qed.

Ltac finite_unpack H :=
  lazymatch type of H with
  | (CharArray.undef_seg _ _ _) _ => idtac
  | (?P ** ?Q) ?h =>
      let a := fresh "ha" in let b := fresh "hb" in
      let K := fresh "parts" in
      destruct H as [a [b K]];
      let rec parts K :=
        lazymatch type of K with
        | join _ _ _ => idtac
        | P a => idtac
        | Q b => idtac
        | _ /\ _ =>
            let L := fresh "part" in let R := fresh "part" in
            destruct K as [L R]; parts L; parts R
        end in
      parts K;
      repeat match goal with
      | K : (_ ** _) _ |- _ => progress finite_unpack K
      end
  | _ => idtac
  end.

Ltac finite_comm_all :=
  let rec collect acc :=
    match goal with
    | J : join ?a ?b ?c |- _ =>
      let Jc := fresh "commuted" in
      let K := fresh "saved" in
      rename J into K;
      revert K;
      collect acc;
      intro K;
      pose proof (join_comm _ _ _ K) as Jc
    | _ => idtac
    end in collect constr:(tt).

Ltac finite_assoc_round :=
  let rec outer :=
    match goal with
    | J : join ?ab ?c ?h |- _ =>
      let rec inner :=
        match goal with
        | K : join ?a ?b ab |- _ =>
          let U := fresh "assoc_parts" in
          let bc := fresh "hbc" in
          let J1 := fresh "assoc_join" in
          let J2 := fresh "assoc_join" in
          pose proof (join_assoc _ _ _ _ _ K J) as U;
          revert K; inner; intro K;
          destruct U as [bc [J1 J2]]
        | _ => idtac
        end in
